newsitem.title: USA: NBC leads U.S. TV ratings for Nov 24 week.
newsitem.headline: NBC leads U.S. TV ratings for Nov 24 week.

text.p: General Electric Co unit NBC took the top spot attracting evening-hours audiences during the week ended November 24 for the U.S. television season.
According to Nielsen Media Research, Westinghouse Electric Corp's CBS and the ABC network owned by Walt Disney Co tied for second place in the number of homes tuned to its evening-hours programs.
The FOX network owned by News Corp Ltd was third.
For the week which ended on Sunday:
-- NBC drew on average 11.6 rating, or percentage, of America's 97 million homes with televisions, and a 19 percent share of homes watching television during those hours;
-- CBS had a rating or 10.0 on average and an 16 percent share of homes watching television;
-- ABC's average rating was 10.2 and its share was 16 percent;
-- FOX had a 8.3 rating and a 13 percent share of audiences;
-- UPN, a unit of Chris-Craft Industries allied with Viacom Inc, had a rating of 3.2 and a share of five percent;
-- WB, a unit of Time Warner Inc, had a 2.9 rating and a four percent share.
